```{r Setup}
#| message: FALSE
#| echo: False

library(tidyverse)
library(questionr)
```


```{r Import}

M1_A3 <- readr::read_csv("../../data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M1_A3.csv",
                         show_col_types = F)

M6_A0 <- haven::read_sas("../../data_hors_git/raw_data/gb_ddb_id_01_qv_06_test.sas7bdat")
```

# Corriger données d'identité

```{r M6_A0 to M6_A2}

# Ajouter id_doublon
M6_A1 <- M6_A0 %>%
  left_join(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(id_anonymat:id_keep),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_keep, .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  select(-id_sep, -id_type, -tab_db) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>% 
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_prenom = replace_when(
      id_prenom,
      id_prenom == "NA" ~ "NAA"
    )
  )

# Remplir les données manquantes de l'identité

M6_A2 <- M6_A1 %>% 
  rows_patch(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(any_of(colnames(M6_A1))),
    by = "id_anonymat",
    unmatched = "ignore"
  ) %>% 
  select(-(qv_type:id_age_cat_3))
```
